name: Alternate Favored Magic
body:
Your dedication to magic studies allows you to tap into different sources of spells.

Prerequisite(s): Human, able to select a favored class bonus allowing to add to the list of spells known or spellbook.

Benefit(s): Next time you could add a spell to your known spells list or spellbook by selecting a favored class bonus, you may choose a spell from a list different from yours. This must still be a spell of the same type you normally cast (arcane, divine, or psychic). For example, an oracle with this feat could select spells from the druid or ranger lists, but not from the bard or wizard lists.
